goal.request: Resume the frozen arm-05 test with the newly available concrete facial-appearance reference, audit exact runtime inputs, render once, and independently score the four required visual gates.

evidence.claim: The official candidate pack, composed prompt, final prompt, profile, and seed remained frozen; final_prompt.txt has SHA-256 46c29c0b6bd4202fdf1ba31d850fb5f8e580aaf40f4507b6309f4c547c4fc5fa.
The concrete 960 by 1280 JPEG reference matched the supplied SHA-256 and was bound only for adult facial appearance and dark wavy hairstyle.
The repository exact-input audit passed with one verified reference, byte-matched negative text, and the frozen final prompt bytes embedded contiguously.
All four visual-obligation evidence phrases are present in the frozen composed prompt; the prior composed audit passed with only a length advisory.
Attempt 01 produced no pixels because the requested conversation image transport exposed zero images.
Built-in imagegen delivered a native 1448 by 1086 PNG using the audited runtime prompt and concrete local reference; no alternate renderer was used.

Thumbnail and native-scale inspection found identifiable former-luxury materials, wear on those same luxury surfaces, readable after-event residue, and an alert adult visibly engaged in unfinished inventory work.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: Former luxury and present material decline coexist on the same surfaces in a readable event aftermath while an awake adult performs a self-directed unfinished action connected to the residue.

invariants.statement: At least one identifiable former-luxury material anchors the environment at thumbnail scale.
causal_controls: velvet, marble, gilding, satin, or crystal remains materially identifiable

invariants.statement: Wear, tarnish, cracking, dust, or peeling affects the same luxury surfaces rather than a separate generic ruin.
causal_controls: surface-localized abrasion, peeling, tarnish, staining, or cracking

invariants.statement: Displaced glassware, spent wax, wilted flowers, ribbons, or comparable residue establishes a recent aftermath.
causal_controls: multiple displaced or spent event objects share the work surface

invariants.statement: The adult is awake, self-directed, and visibly mid-action with residue or worn material rather than merely posed.
causal_controls: open eyes, upright posture, both hands engaged with an inventory object and ledger

mismatches.render_state: Attempt 01 was unavailable because no conversation image reached the tool; attempt 02 delivered pixels after concrete path binding.

hypotheses.statement: The earlier block was a reference-transport failure rather than prompt or pixel failure; binding the supplied concrete path and digest should allow the same frozen prompt to render.
hypotheses.falsifier: The exact-input audit rejects the concrete reference or built-in imagegen again returns no image while using the verified local path.

intervention.general_rule: No prompt-skill source change was made; only the reference transport was resumed with concrete bytes while all authored inputs remained frozen.
intervention.generalization_basis: The motivating failure was external transport, so altering prompt semantics would not address the earliest supported divergence.

decision.rationale: This frozen arm produced one all-four-gates pixel pass after concrete reference binding. The conclusion is limited to this motivating case; no unrelated holdout or user aesthetic judgment supports promotion.
